literal_meaning: ল্যাকের জাতীয় চকচকে পদার্থ বা পালিশ
figurative_meaning_en: colloquial expression of beauty; luster; charm
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ফুলের ছিরি দেখে মুগ্ধ হয়ে গেলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: Her luster has really bloomed today.
I was mesmerized by the flower's radiant charm.
note: Refers to a shiny polish metaphorically for personal radiance in Bengali expression.
